cases.name: ARM NEON rejected at baseline
cases.reason: LLVM 22.1.8 and 23.1.5 handling of ARMv7 NEON with an unspecified feature mask varies between build contexts. Native and WASM may both accept it, while other matching builds reject it natively and accept it in WASM. Explicit -neon,-mve and +neon agree.

expected_signatures.description: Native and WASM both accept despite the baseline policy
